pages.text: Replace mode can only pull rectangles; drawing arcs requires $(bold)splines$(): click anchors in the world to draw curves, used for building curves, loops, and interchanges.
Press $(bold)V$() → the $(bold)Roads$() icon → click $(bold)Spline$(); an edit panel appears on the right side of the screen. $(bold)ESC$() or the panel's "Close" exits.
pages.title: Entering & Exiting

pages.text: After entering the editor, $(bold)WASD no longer moves the character, but controls the camera$(). Flying works the same as overview mode: $(bold)WASD/Space/Shift$() to fly at any time, $(bold)right-click drag$() to rotate the view, $(bold)scroll wheel$() to zoom. Flight speed is fixed and can be adjusted in the mod config under $(#8a5a2b)panel.flySpeed$().$(br2)Two editor-only keys: $(bold)G$() switches to 2D top-down view, $(bold)H$() opens this guide.$(br2)With the cursor free, click the panel or control points in the world; right-click drag rotates the view.
pages.title: Camera Controls

pages.text: $(li)In the panel's "$(bold)Click to Add Point$()" mode, $(bold)left-click$() a block surface in the world — that adds an anchor. Add two or more, and the curve preview appears.$(li)$(bold)Left-click$() an anchor to select it; an $(bold)RGB 3D axis$() appears around it (red X / green Y / blue Z). $(bold)Hold and drag an axis$() to move the anchor along it. The $(bold)tangent handles$() at both ends control the arc.$(li)Want a symmetric bend on both sides? Keep "Symmetric Tangent Handle Lock" on; hold $(bold)Shift$() while dragging to temporarily move only one side.$(li)Delete a point: select it and press $(bold)Delete$() / $(bold)Backspace$(), or use the panel's "Delete Node".
pages.title: Drawing a Curve

pages.text: The "$(bold)Array Generation$()" tab turns the curve into a road:$(br2)$(li)$(bold)Material$() follows the preset selected in the V panel's bottom bar; switching materials updates the preview in real time.$(li)$(bold)Width$() (1~15 blocks), $(bold)base layer thickness$() (1~3 layers), $(bold)stone shoulder edging$() (check to line both sides with stone bricks).$(li)A smaller $(bold)sample step$() makes it smoother; keep the $(bold)3D preview$() on to see the effect.$(li)Once confirmed, click "$(bold)Submit Construction Task$()" and the wizards will execute the paving.
pages.title: Generating a Road

pages.text: The "Templates & Tools" tab lets you save the current curve as a template under a name, stored in $(#8a5a2b)<game dir>/config/wandscape/splines/$(). Loading it next time places it with your current position as the origin.
pages.title: Saving Templates

pages.text: $(bold)Broken blocks at sharp corners?$() The control handles are pulled too long and the curvature is too extreme. Shorten the handles (2~4 blocks), or reduce the sample step (e.g. to 1.0).$(br2)$(bold)Dragging one axis moves the other side too?$() That is the "Symmetric Tangent Handle Lock". Hold Shift while dragging to release it temporarily, or uncheck it in the panel.$(br2)$(l:wandscape:road_replace_guide)Replace Mode (Surface Paving)$(/l)$(br2)$(l:wandscape:road_guide)Road System Overview$(/l)$(br2)$(l:wandscape:index_guide)Back to the Guide Index$(/l)
